column5: Oh, found one with a prize!

column4: 魔物大将軍、ランスの事を知らない、わざわざやられに来たか人間どもめ
column5: Great Monster General: Don't know who Rance is, huh? Did you come all the way here just to get killed, humans?

column4: ん、隊列もバラバラ、服装や装備もバラバラ、お前ら正規軍ではなく野良の傭兵か
column5: Hmm, your formation is messy, your clothes and equipment are all over the place. You're not regular troops but some stray mercenaries?

column4: やめておけ、お前らでは私の相手にはならぬぞ
column5: Better stop. You're no match for me.

column4: ふん、俺様のオーラが見えぬとはランクの低い奴だな、まぁいいひとつ聞こう
column5: Hmph, not being able to see my aura means you're low rank. Well, fine, let me ask you one thing.

column4: お前の腹に入っている女の子は美人か
column5: Is the girl inside your belly a beautiful one?

column4: ん、頭脳として入れている人間の事か、そんなのしらんわ。
column5: Huh? You mean the human I have inside as my brain? I don't know anything about that.

column4: まぁ、いい、割れば分かるか。
column5: Well, fine. I'll find out once I break you.
